name: John Olson Advanced Manufacturing Center
use: Advanced manufacturing teaching, research and industry partnerships: machining, light materials, flexible electronics, cleanroom; co-located companies
builtText: Center founded 2016; opened June 2018 in the former Goss International building
statusNote: Moving to the NOAA Center of Excellence building in fall 2027

renovations.what: 950 sq ft ISO 7 cleanroom unveiled (donated by Airtho)

facts.text: Founded in 2016 with a $5.3 million gift from Whelen Engineering in honor of alumnus John Olson (class of 1957).
Planned for the former Goss International building on the west edge of campus.
A 950 sq ft ISO 7 cleanroom was unveiled in 2025; seven technology businesses are co-located with about 24 UNH students.
The new 70,500 sq ft Center of Excellence building at Main Street and Mast Road will also house the Olson Center when it opens in fall 2027.
